description: This file defines functions to create and load different variants of the DETR object detection model, including backbone configurations, pre-trained weights, and post-processing options. It specifically contains factory functions for models like detr_resnet50, detr_resnet101, and their panoptic versions with variations like DC5 dilations.

methods.name: _make_detr(backbone_name: str, dilation=False, num_classes=91, mask=False)
methods.description: Factory function to create a DETR model with specified backbone and options.

methods.name: detr_resnet50(pretrained=False, num_classes=91, return_postprocessor=False)
methods.description: Constructs a DETR model with a ResNet-50 backbone, optionally loading pretrained weights, and returning a post-processor.

methods.name: detr_resnet50_dc5(pretrained=False, num_classes=91, return_postprocessor=False)
methods.description: Constructs a DETR model with ResNet-50 backbone and DC5 dilation, optionally loading pretrained weights.

methods.name: detr_resnet101(pretrained=False, num_classes=91, return_postprocessor=False)
methods.description: Constructs a DETR model with a ResNet-101 backbone, optionally loading pretrained weights.

methods.name: detr_resnet101_dc5(pretrained=False, num_classes=91, return_postprocessor=False)
methods.description: Constructs a DETR model with ResNet-101 backbone with DC5 dilation, optionally loading pretrained weights.

methods.name: detr_resnet50_panoptic( pretrained=False, num_classes=250, threshold=0.85, return_postprocessor=False )
methods.description: Constructs a ResNet-50 based panoptic DETR model, with threshold for segments, optionally loading pretrained weights.

methods.name: detr_resnet50_dc5_panoptic( pretrained=False, num_classes=250, threshold=0.85, return_postprocessor=False )
methods.description: Constructs a ResNet-50 DC5 panoptic DETR model.

methods.name: detr_resnet101_panoptic( pretrained=False, num_classes=250, threshold=0.85, return_postprocessor=False )
methods.description: Constructs a ResNet-101 panoptic DETR model.

methods.name: detr_resnet101_dc5_panoptic
methods.description: Constructs a ResNet-101 DC5 panoptic DETR model.
